title: Data Availability
summary: The guarantee in SORA Nexus that every transaction's payload can be reconstructed by honest parties, even when the original submitter goes offline, preventing data withholding attacks.
definition: The guarantee in SORA Nexus that every transaction's payload can be reconstructed by honest parties, even when the original submitter goes offline, preventing data withholding attacks.
tagline: Prevents data withholding attacks that could halt chain progress or hide fraud.
